changelog: The Roaming Warband is now a true moving elite: it's led by a mobile Command Vehicle that drives around the map dodging your units instead of sitting in a base — chase it down before it slips away. The Fire Swamp's Rodents of Unusual Size hit softer (4 damage) with half the health, and the Fire Swamp itself is now a rare 1-in-20 encounter instead of showing up almost every run. Ordnance like Air Strike, Ion Cannon and Barrage can now hit enemies and bases that your Recon reveals through the fog for the turn. Also includes a big download-size cut (leaner art) and the new iOS build.
